breakdown.description: The boundary condition of fixedValue (0 0.1 0) is set at outlet, but it should be the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applied a set of boundary conditions to the 'outlet' when they should have been applied to the 'inlet'. The generated specification repeated this error, stating 'Outlet boundary conditions set...', whereas the ground truth correctly states 'Boundary conditions at the inlet set...'.
